results.issue_title: URL encoded route parameters not handled correctly

with_squoze.label: With Squoze v2

without_squoze.label: Without Squoze (Baseline)
without_squoze.patchPreview: Root cause: routing resolved the path by reading `r.URL.RawPath` and falling back to `r.URL.Path`. `net/url` only populates `RawPath` when the default encoding of `Path` doesn't round-trip, so for many encoded paths it is empty and matching happens against the *decoded* path — turning `%2F` into a real separator and splitting one segment into two.
